_howToLabel: One entry per notice in permits.json, or per event in calendar.json and the Linked Events Adapter fixture (layer calendar). Fill in the null fields; do not edit id, layer, text, candidateDates or tyoPaattyy.
severity (traffic arrangements): info | minor | consider | major
crowd (outdoor events, calendar): under_1000 | 1000_or_more, how many people at once at the busiest moment
loud (digs): loud | ordinary, whether the work is loud enough to hear from inside nearby homes day after day
mainlyAffected (permit layers): drivers | cyclists | pedestrians | transit | parking | everyone | nobody | unknown
mainlyAffected may be a list when several groups are equally affected; Jev's single answer counts as correct if it is any of them.
workType (digs): water_sewer | district_heating | electricity_telecom | paving | street_construction | building_site | other
arrangementType (traffic arrangements): detour | walk_cycle_route | traffic_signs | parking | stop_moved | site_access | event | other, what the arrangement changes
endDate (digs): one of candidateDates, or "not_stated". tyoPaattyy is the city's field value, shown for reference only.
candidateDates are the dates the Classifier offers Jev (from candidateDates() in questions.ts): d.m.yyyy, 'd.m. yyyy' and ISO dates; a date without a year takes the year of the next full date.

decision (every layer): change_plans | worth_knowing | no_effect, whether an ordinary person passing through or going there would change their route, time, mode or parking. A moved stop or a parking ban changes plans even for one stop or car park; so does an arena event of about 8,000 or more.
Leave null when you think the Classifier shouldn't be confident (below the threshold); only filled answers are checked.
